title: Cardinal Billing Account Plan Entry Matrix: Payment Methods, Autopay, Filings and Pay Plan Discount
content:
Each Cardinal Billing Account pay plan accepts a set list of payment methods, may require automatic payments, may or may not be used by a policy carrying an SR-22 or FR-44 financial-responsibility filing, and carries a pay plan discount that enters the auto rating discount sum.

| Pay plan | Check or money order | Credit card | Debit card | Bank EFT | Autopay required | Policy with an SR-22 or FR-44 filing may use the plan | Pay plan discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | No | No | 0 percent |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | Not accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Not accepted | Yes | Yes | 0 percent |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | Not accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted | Accepted | Yes | Yes | 3 percent |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | No | Yes | 0 percent |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | No | Yes | 4 percent |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | Accepted | No | Yes | 8 percent |

## Points of judgement drawn from the matrix

- The Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan is the only plan a policy carrying an SR-22 or FR-44 filing may not use.
- The two autopay plans each accept a single kind of method: cards only on the Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan, bank EFT only on the Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan; both require autopay.
- A check or money order is accepted only on the Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan, Cardinal Three-Pay Plan, Cardinal Two-Pay Plan and Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan.
- The pay plan discount is a percentage entered into the auto rating discount sum; it is highest on the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan (8 percent), then the Cardinal Two-Pay Plan (4 percent) and the Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan (3 percent).

Hypothetical reading: a policy carrying an SR-22 filing whose holder wants to pay by check fits the Cardinal Three-Pay Plan, Cardinal Two-Pay Plan or Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan, and none of the autopay plans.
